description: Ready Check session rule, task records and finished-task reminder.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook session-start --client claude || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook session-start --client claude || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook session-start --client claude

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook prompt --client claude || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook prompt --client claude || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook prompt --client claude

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook answer --client claude || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook answer --client claude || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook answer --client claude

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook stop --client claude || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook stop --client claude || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ready-check.py" hook stop --client claude
